Name: (CP) Mountain View Redone
Author: EmissaryOfWind
Description:
A replacer for the mountain view and trees in the opening screen, the summit and the day's revenue screen. Requires Content Patcher.
Half of Donation Points from downloads of this mod will be given to Ukraine relief ??

Update 1.1: Now also replaces the mountains in Harvey's 10 heart event.

Installation:
- Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher
[/url]- Unzip this mod and drop the contents in your Stardew Valley/Mods folder﻿﻿
